title: Inbox One
description: Builds on the conversation-shaped Summary (the viewer's V7, id inbox-one-v6) without its chat bubble or card grid. The Task is a lead paragraph under a sentence-case "Task" heading, no longer a chat request bubble. A one-line agent status ("Claude finished and is ready for review") then leads the agent's summary or progress, with model, workspace, branch and environment in its tooltip. Below a divider, Artifacts shows the visual changes card, then plain lists instead of cards. Pull request is a single row with the PR number and title, its status (or Agent Merge status) and Ready to Merge inline. Checks and Changes are hairline-separated lists under a header row the same height as their rows, carrying the overall status ("All passing") or file count and diff totals.
